title: Skeleton branch graph (Skan)
description: Skan extracts paths and branch lengths from an original one-pixel-wide skeleton. Highlight a branch to inspect its topology.
description_ko: Skan으로 직접 만든 1픽셀 골격에서 경로와 가지 길이를 구했어요. 가지별 결과를 살펴보세요.
prompt: Skeleton branch graph. Inspect the locally generated results and rerun the included recipe when changing simulation inputs.
made_with: skan==0.13.1, numpy==2.2.6; executed locally on macOS arm64
summary: Skan extracts paths and branch lengths from an original one-pixel-wide skeleton. Highlight a branch to inspect its topology.

tool_about: Skan extracts paths and branch lengths from an original one-pixel-wide skeleton. Highlight a branch to inspect its topology. The viewer only reads prepared data; computation is in the recipe.
